entities.summary: The Church of South India (CSI) is a united Protestant Church in India. It is the result of union of a number of Protestant denominations in South India that occurred after the independence of India. With a membership of over 4.5 million - 5 million, it is the second-largest Christian church based on the number of members in India. Anglican Church of South India is a Christian denomination in Asia, established in 1947-09-03. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
